title: in berlin soaring rents take center stage in an election campaign dominated by the radical left

title: with the le pens family always comes first marine le pen launches campaign surrounded by relatives and loyalists

title: 2027 presidential election le pen begins campaign in strongest position ever amid worried angry electorate
